1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario addresses the current behavior of the Tabs component, which switches from a traditional horizontal tablist (second screenshot) to a dropdown (first screenshot) when the browser width becomes small. This dropdown variant not only bases its trigger on the browser's width instead of the actual component's space, but also impacts accessibility negatively by misleading screen readers into perceiving a listbox/dropdown rather than a tablist. The bug report proposes removing this dropdown variant and finding an alternative responsive behavior.

2.bug_scenario: The bug report describes an issue where the Tab component in the UI library transforms into a dropdown at smaller screen widths.
